reason: An Electron desktop wrapper for DeepSeek Harness that provides a standalone window, automatically detects or starts the local web service, can install the service through npx, and records configuration and logs.

summaries.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 本地 Web 界面封装为 Electron 桌面应用，并提供服务检测、启动、安装、日志记录与窗口管理功能。
summaries.en: An Electron desktop wrapper for the local DeepSeek Harness web interface with service detection, startup, installation, logging, and window management.

capabilities: Launches and manages a local DeepSeek Harness web service
Automatically downloads and installs DeepSeek Harness with npx when configured
Detects Node.js and local service availability
Terminates services started by the application on exit when configured
Writes service logs and configuration files to the user data directory
Opens a local web interface in an Electron desktop window
